mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual rate > 5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement aggressive monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL annual rate exceeds 5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in new housing starts (HOUST) below 1,100,000 units signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 1,100,000 units, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the last 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and new housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based weakness in consumer spending and the housing market, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) is associated with positive short-term equity returns, as the market prices in immediate accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
